operations.description: Use 100 mm tissue-culture-treated dishes coated with 50 µg/mL type I rat-tail collagen and BEGM. Maintain humidified 37 °C and 5% CO2; feed twice weekly; passage by trypsinization. Experiments in triplicate using passages 3–7.

operations.description: Negative MUA/MPA: 20, 80, 160 µg/mL. Positive dose labels differ by assay/panel: general methods 0.5, 5, 20 µg/mL; Figures 2B, 3D, 4B, 5B use 0.5, 3.5, 20; Figure 3B images and Figures 5D/6 use their explicit labels. Never merge 3.5 and 5. Use phenol-red-free HBSS for ROS, otherwise BEGM; retain humidified 37 °C and 5% CO2.

value.value: Preliminary negative-QD exposures 0.5–20 µg/mL did not show significant cytotoxicity, while positive-QD effects occurred even at 0.5 µg/mL. These prose-only preliminary ranges are not extra structural samples.

value.value: One-way ANOVA with pairwise Tukey tests in SigmaPlot 11.0; minimum three independent experiments using different cell passage numbers; log or square-root transforms when needed for normality/equal variance.
